thread:
lina_finance: Heads-up: CloudHarbor (channel partner) filed a ticket claiming they were double-billed for April marketplace usage. They say AWS invoice includes both marketplace metering and our direct invoice for the same subscription id.

oscar_sales: that's bad. Which subscription? any customer impacted or just partner internal testing?

sam_cloudharbor: subscription id 4443332221. Attached is their AWS invoice PDF and the partner statement: https://files.cloudharbor.io/invoices/apr-4443332221.pdf. They claim line items appear twice with different dimensions.

billing-bot: :mag_right: Alert: Possible duplicate billing detected for subscription 4443332221. Marketplace meter and platform ledger show overlapping dimensions for dates 2026-04-01..2026-04-30.

jess_ops: pulled our ledger and the marketplace report. Quick diff shows a mismatch: AWS metering has a dimension "redwood.tokens.marketplace" with 152,000 units; our internal invoicing also recorded 152,000 units but tagged as "partner_forwarded" for the same date range. Looks like an ingestion rule duplicated partner-forwarded events. Snippet:

```
aws_meter: 2026-04-12, subscription 4443332221, redwood.tokens.marketplace, 152000
platform_ledger: 2026-04-12, subscription 4443332221, partner_forwarded.tokens, 152000
```

lina_finance: If that's true, the customer only paid AWS once but CloudHarbor is asking us to refund the duplicate they say we invoiced them for. Do we have proof of payment?

sam_cloudharbor: customer was billed by AWS only. CloudHarbor forwarded the marketplace usage to us for resale settlements and they weren't expecting a separate Redwood invoice. They included our invoice showing a $228.00 charge for the 152k tokens.

marta_legal: need to confirm contract pathing. If CloudHarbor is a reseller, agreements specify we should not invoice the partner for market-metered usage unless explicitly flagged as reseller-processed. Check onboarding flag "reseller_mode" for account 4443332221.

oscar_sales: iirc they were onboarded in reseller_mode=true, but there was a migration last quarter. Could be a flag flip.

jess_ops: confirmed: reseller_mode was true until 2026-03-31, on 2026-04-01 an automated migration script reset reseller_mode=false for several partner accounts (bug GH-523). That caused the system to generate direct invoices in April.

billing-bot: incident_link: https://intradb/issues/GH-523. status: triaged.

lina_finance: Ok root cause identified. Next: quantify the exposure and propose remediation. Jess, what's the refund amount to CloudHarbor?

jess_ops: invoice line was $228.00 (platform invoice 2026-04-15 #RD-5553). We should refund that to partner settlement account. Also need to correct our settlements to downstream sellers/customers so we don't double-reconcile.

marta_legal: contractually we should issue refund and notify affected customers. Also include an internal waiver: we won't accept liability for prior months until we finish the migration audit, but this April charge is our bug.

oscar_sales: propose we (A) refund partner $228, (B) provide a credit to their reseller ledger, (C) include a one-time admin credit of $50 as apology. Thoughts?

lina_finance: Finance ok with $228 refund + $50 goodwill if sales thinks it's worth it. Need approvals: (1) finance ops to issue refund, (2) ops to patch migration and reprocess April settlements, (3) legal to send notification language.

jess_ops: will patch GH-523 today and kick reprocess job. I'll attach reprocess report when done.

sam_cloudharbor: we'll accept the refund and admin credit, please send a settlement note we can share with our accounting.

marta_legal: I'll draft the notice to CloudHarbor stating root cause, refund amount, and that this is a one-time remediation. Include link to reprocessed settlement CSV.

lina_finance: Action items: Lina to approve refund txn, Jess to run reprocess and provide CSV, Marta to send legal notice, Oscar to confirm partner accepts goodwill credit. Target close: 48 hours.

billing-bot: action_required: refund_created by lina_finance amount 278.00 status pending.

oscar_sales: confirming partner accepted. Sam, can you send payment instructions for where to apply refund?

sam_cloudharbor: refund to partner-settlement-account CH-ACCT-77. We'll reconcile and confirm. Thanks for quick response. :pray:
